card.title: HIMEJI REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 39th Infantry Regiment Himeji was attached to the 10th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army, which was code named the "Iron Division". The division fought in the Russo-Japanese War, the Second Sino-Japanese War and during WWII. By the end of WWII they were sent to  Luzon in the Philippines to fight against the American forces where the division was almost entirely annihilated in the Battle of Luzon in 1945. However, the 39th Regiment continued a guerrilla war until the surrender of Japan on August 15, 1945.
